name: Conformance: Approval (timeout, onTimeout approve)
description: RFC 0223 / openwop#1696. An approval gate with a 1500 ms timeoutMs and onTimeout: approve. Nobody resolves it: a timeout never grants, so the host's timer resolves the gate rejected (action timeout, decision rejected, reason timeout), the gate fails with approval_rejected and the run fails. Conformance scenario: v2-approval-reject-disposition.test.ts.
